methodology.description: Isolation Forest trained on NASA C-MAPSS FD001 training set with sliding window features. Evaluated on held-out test set using ground truth RUL for binary degradation classification.
methodology.train_test_split: Official NASA split: train_FD001.txt (100 engines, run-to-failure) / test_FD001.txt (100 engines, partial trajectories) with RUL_FD001.txt ground truth
methodology.preprocessing: MinMaxScaler fitted on training data only, applied to both train and test
methodology.rul_labeling: Piecewise linear degradation, clipped at 125 cycles
methodology.degradation_threshold: Final 30% of engine life classified as degraded

evaluation_note: Isolation Forest is an unsupervised anomaly detector; F1 scores in the 0.4-0.6 range are expected for this approach on C-MAPSS. Supervised deep learning models (LSTM, CNN) typically achieve RMSE 12-14 on RUL regression.
